title: Epilepsy, Parkinson's disease and multiple sclerosis
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's neurological condition.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis.

HPI: [Copied Forward] Patient is a 78-year-old male with a history of relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis. He reports stable neurological symptoms with no recent exacerbations or significant changes in mobility. He continues to manage symptoms effectively with his current regimen.

Update: The patient reports feeling well today. He denies any new episodes of numbness or weakness. He notes that his current disease-modifying therapy remains effective in maintaining his functional status.

Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 74, SpO2 98% on room air, Temp 98.6 F.

Review of Systems:
Neurological: Positive for stable symptoms of relapsing-remitting MS; Negative for new focal deficits.
Musculoskeletal: Negative for new joint pain.
Constitutional: Negative for fatigue or weight changes.

Exam: Patient is alert and oriented x3. Gait is steady with a normal stride. Muscle strength is 5/5 in all extremities. No new tremors or involuntary movements noted. Reflexes are symmetric.

Assessment: 78-year-old male with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis. He remains stable on his current disease-modifying therapy.

Medication List: 
- Disease-modifying therapy (Current)
- Multivitamin

Plan: 
1. Continue current medication regimen for relapsing-remitting MS.
2. Routine follow-up in 6 months.
3. Patient instructed to report any sudden changes in symptoms immediately.

Electronically signed,
R. Mensah, NP
May 14, 2026
explanations: Relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis: G35.A (HCC 198). G35 itself is a header in FY2027.

distractors.why: G35 needs more characters in FY2027.
